metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · The Promised Land
metas.description: The story of Danish soldier and explorer Ludvig Kahlen, who explored and cultivated Denmark's wild Jutland, which now comprises the vast majority of the country, in the mid-18th century.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Chandu Champion
metas.description: A man who faced one adversary after another with an undying spirit. His unwavering zeal and never give up attitude led to India's first individual gold medal in any form of the Olympics.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2022 · Major
metas.description: Based on the life of Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, who fought during the November 2008 Mumbai attacks.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Amaran
metas.description: The life of Major Mukund Varadarajan and is set against the backdrop of the Qazipathri Operation in Shopian, Kashmir, which took place back in 2014.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Mission Raniganj
metas.description: When a flood leaves dozens of workers trapped in a coal mine, an engineer embarks on a daring rescue mission to save them. Inspired by real events.
